submission.evidence: incident/stderr.txt traceback ends at app/app.py line 56 INSERT INTO payments; incident/ledger.db balances available=100000 reserved=0, no payments row, no postings.
submission.external_outcome: No provider request was made; the failure happened before the transport was called, so nothing exists at the provider.
submission.local_state: Nothing was committed: no payment row, no reservation, 100000 cents available, no posting; the ledger is unchanged.
submission.reproduction: Start from a fresh ledger seeded with 100000 cents and the success fixture. Inject a failure on INSERT INTO payments (a trigger raising 'database or disk is full') and run the payment. Assert exit status 1 with IntegrityError in stderr, balances unchanged (available 100000, reserved 0), zero payment rows, and that the fixture transport was never called.
submission.recovery: Fix storage, then simply retry the same payment_id with the same parameters; because no reservation or request exists there is nothing to reconcile. Do not mark the payment as sent.
